evidence.title: ArtBlast - #1 Daily Game Art Jobs Newsletter | 3D Artist, Concept Artist, VFX Jobs

name: Subscribe to ArtBlast
summary: Signup form for ArtBlast, a daily newsletter of curated 3D, 2D, VFX, concept and animation art jobs for 14,240+ artists.
description: Three-step subscription flow that first asks what kind of art job you are looking for. The newsletter emails 10-60+ curated art jobs every morning, with a free tier, a $7/month premium tier, discipline-specific job lists (3D, 2D, VFX, UI, concept, animation, environment), Discord job alerts and a salary calculator.
